messages:
eli: quick check-in: proposing a runtime rule: reject org-scoped wildcard API keys for service endpoints unless explicitly allowlisted.
maya: +1. What's the failure mode for CI? will builds break?
tom: some internal jobs use org keys today. recommend detection-only phase first, then deny with allowlist.
eli: agreed: plan = detect-only (2w) -> canary deny -> org-wide deny. allowlist entries require owner+expiry.
maya: enforcement at gateway or authn layer? gateway gives toggles. ops-bot: policy staged: scope_enforce=detect@gateway-canary.
tom: UX: warn on org-key creation, default TTL 7d, checkbox to allow runtime (creates ticket).
eli: long-term: broker that mints short-lived project tokens after ACL checks. reduces key sprawl.
maya: traceability: ensure origin_key_id + broker_subject propagate to logs.
tom: ok to draft RFC with migration checklist. can review Fri.
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-6123 to track broker PoC and gateway rollout.
